messages:
natalie.ciso: Quick org notice: We're performing an HSM-backed KMS key rollover for the primary production key (redwood-prod-hsm) this week. This is driven by updated crypto guidance (NIST/industry) and a small number of signature verifications that flagged legacy wrapping schemes. This affects Hosted API, Dedicated pools, and some Private HSM installs.

tom.sre: ETA on the window? will this require restarts?

natalie.ciso: Planned rollout: staging tomorrow 22:00 UTC, canary to a subset of Dedicated pods Wednesday 02:00 UTC, global prod Saturday 03:0006:00 UTC. We expect zero restarts for modern agents; older on-prem HSMs may need the key imported or agent reload.

jen.devex: Any quick checklist for customers on Private? want to pre-send instructions to our account contacts.

natalie.ciso: Yes 10-point checklist in the runbook: https://go/redwood/security/hsm-rollover. Key points: (1) verify HSM firmware >= 2.4, (2) export public wrapping key from new HSM and install on appliance, (3) reconfirm key policy bindings, (4) verify partner connector trust bundles.

sec-automation-bot: Scan summary: 9 Dedicated connectors use legacy RSA-OAEP-SHA1 wrapping, 4 Private customers reported HSM firmware <2.4, 27 CI jobs still referencing the wrapped key id. Report: https://go/redwood/sec/hsm-rollover-report

mike.partner-success: Heads-up: I'll email partners with manual import steps and contact SLA. Any pre-built scripts for them?

natalie.ciso: We have two helpers: a one-shot import script for appliances and an idempotent agent-side refresh. For appliances: `scp new-hsm-pub.pem appliance:/tmp && ssh appliance 'sudo /opt/redwood/hsm/import_pub.sh /tmp/new-hsm-pub.pem'`. For agent refresh (clients >= v2.0): `curl -fsS https://pkg.redwood.ai/agent/refresh-hsm-key | sudo bash`.

ops-oncall: What about CI runners that unwrap wrapped keys? We have a bunch of long-lived wrapped creds in GitLab runners.

natalie.ciso: Migrate CI to OIDC short-lived tokens ASAP. Guidance: https://go/redwood/devops/ci-oidc. If you cannot migrate before the window, follow the temporary mitigation: create a surrogate service principal bound to the new key and rotate the wrapped secret in the runner config before the prod window.

psa-infra: For cloud KMS owners: GCP quick rotate snippet: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=redwood-prod --location=global && gcloud kms keys versions set-primary <new-version-id> --key=redwood-prod`. For Azure Key Vault with HSM: `az keyvault key create --name redwood-prod --kty RSA-HSM --hsm` then update alias mapping.

jen.devex: We'll push a short FAQ and contact list to the customer portal and notify Dedicated customers directly.

tom.sre: I'll set temporary alert thresholds for KMS API errors and 5xx surge during the windows; ops-oncall will page if anything anomalous.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll add runbook links to the incident playbook and standby on the page.

natalie.ciso: Action items for this thread: (a) infra teams run the staging rollover and confirm results in this thread, (b) eng teams audit CI and migrate wrapped keys, (c) devex send partner/private customer instructions, (d) oncall set alerts for KMS failures. Target full completion in 72 hours post-prod window.

mike.partner-success: Will notify partners today and update tickets with the import script.

jen.devex: Sending portal update now.

tom.sre: Starting staging run at 22:00 UTC and will post outcome. :hammer_and_wrench:
